title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-07
source: flac16/48kHz; 7 Inch Half Track Reel Master @ 7.5 ips(Recorded In Venue By Bear on a Sony 770 Reel 2 Reel)- 1st Generation Cassettes (TDK SA-X 100's) Taped By Dick Latvala(Technics 1506 Reel 2 Reel-Tascam 122 MK111 Cassette Deck no dolby); Analog to Digital Transfer(Dick's Cassettes played back on Nakamichi Dragon- Sony PCM-R500 DAT @ 44.1KHz by Jim Wise circa 1997); DAT play back on a Sony PCM R-500-Analog out-Sony PCM R-700 Analog in @ 48KHz-Digital Audio Labs Carddeluxe-WAV @ 16/48kHz; Editing(Adobe Audition 3.0)-Mastering(iZotope Ozone 6)-FLAC Encoding(dBpoweramp)-Tagging(Tag & Re-name)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience recording of a rare 1970 show with standout Other One and Cryptical Reprise performances.
ai_review.review: The Bear/Jim Wise tape delivers an exceptionally clear, almost studio‑like sound that lets listeners hear every nuance of this elusive 1970 concert.  While most fans rave about the soaring Other One sequence and a memorable Cryptical Reprise, a few note that the playing is occasionally unfocused, making the overall performance solid but not flawless.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelming praise for recording clarity (30% weight) and generally strong musical moments (70% weight), with only a handful of modest criticisms keeping the rating just below “exceptional”.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear, crisp sound; superb mic placement captures both ambience and detail without noticeable muddiness or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Acoustic‑focused first set that transitions into a cosmic, exploratory second set; overall flow praised though some reviewers felt parts of the electric set were a bit unfocused.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's vocal is largely buried in favor of a mysterious “yodeler”; no specific guitar commentary.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drummers lock in during high‑energy moments, driving the crowd into a frenzy.
